title: Effect proposal (readback, phase 1)
description: Before any side-effectful tool executes, the executor states its structured interpretation of what it is about to do (R5/IP-8). The proposal is compared MACHINE-wise against intent constraints; prose plays no role in the decision.

effect_class.description: unclassified is legal to STATE but deny-fast to EXECUTE — new tools must be classified before they may act.

target.description: Machine identifier of the affected entity (table row, URL host, file path…).

params_sha256.description: Hash of the exact parameters that will execute — confirm binds to THIS hash.
